## Description

Builds and grades a proxy-industry demand-estimation chain (e.g. crankshaft -> marine engine -> ship) for target industries with no direct market data. Data confidence from this chain caps the overall RAG grade downstream. Use when: "proxy chain", "no direct market data", "chain reliability grade", "demand estimation via proxy industry".
